notes.title: Update That's finally here
notes.notes:
Not all things promised in the last development update promised happened. I am still working on those goals

Update includes
- Voice chat
- PC players
- VR instant grab
- New avatar
- Friend Invites

This update was a rebuild of lots of the core essentials of the game, so it broke a lot of previous features. Those things will be brought back with weekly updates

- laser pointer
- trail color for weapons
- parking lot level
- bandana selection

But most importantly I am finally in a position where i can comfortably continue to add new content!

notes.title: Major Update scheduled for the start of June
notes.notes:
Hello Knife Club players,

We are working on a major update, which will address some major concerns people provided feedback on. Knife Club will also be adding PC support to help fill the gap of finding players online.

Some features include
- New avatar
- PC player
- Instant grab
- Voice
- Mini Games
- Extension to the lobby
- Bug fixes
- And more changes to come

- The new avatar has been made to support customization in the future

And most importantly all Knife Club developers (a group of 4 brothers) are returning to full force to continue to support Knife Club, so new content will be more frequent. See you in the Club!

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.06 Pre-launch
notes.notes:
Thanks for all of the beta users for testing the game!
- Special shout out for bug finders
-Para(dissonance), Coffee4ever, Gibberish, and many more

- Increased movement speed of Joystick and Touchpad option.
- Fixed some menu bugs.
- Updated graphics of weapons (further improvments yet to come).
- Fixed a spawning item bug, which was preventing some rounds from starting.
- Updated some scene objects (more Halloween stuff also yet to come).
- Fixed dropping items when someone else dies.
- Added a delay before all 4 players load a level.
- Networked points on the lobby points score boards.
- Trench barrier walls set further back.
- Changed some core game logic for stability.
- Bunch of minor fixes and tweaks.
